name: Seal Beach
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Seal Beach, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Seal Beach and Los Alamitos, California for 2026: the Main Street Christmas Parade, Winter Wonderland at St. Isidore Historical Plaza and library art classes.
lede: Seal Beach celebrates Christmas with the Seal Beach Lions Club parade down Main Street, and neighboring Los Alamitos adds a free snowy Winter Wonderland at St. Isidore Historical Plaza.
celebrates: Seal Beach's season starts with the annual Christmas Parade on Main Street, produced by the Seal Beach Lions Club, with a 2026 theme celebrating 250 years of freedom and Santa Claus last in line. Next door, the City of Los Alamitos holds its 15th annual Winter Wonderland at St. Isidore Historical Plaza, with snow sledding, Santa's Village with Santa and the Grinch, a tree lighting and crafts. OC Public Libraries adds winter art classes at the Los Alamitos-Rossmoor and Seal Beach Mary Wilson branches.
lastyear: The Seal Beach Sun reported that the 2026 parade is the 48th annual, and that the Seal Beach tree lighting at the pier was held on Saturday, November 21 this season, before the parade. Los Alamitos's Winter Wonderland is the 15th annual, according to the city's announcement. Both fall on the first weekend of December: the parade on Friday, December 4, and Winter Wonderland on Saturday, December 5.
facts: The Seal Beach Sun says the Seal Beach Lions Club holds five special event permits from the city this year, including the parade, and that the parade chairman reports 91 entries in 2026, the largest number since the pandemic. The City of Los Alamitos names MemorialCare Miller Children's and Women's Hospital Long Beach as title sponsor of Winter Wonderland.
trains: Seal Beach has no Christmas train of its own, though the Seal Beach Pier and Main Street are an easy walk from the Orange County line. Nearby, the free Fullerton Train Museum, with seven vintage railcars and a Metrolink locomotive, opens on the first and third Saturdays of each month, according to our museum page. Costa Mesa's South Coast Plaza runs Santa's Express Train for $2 a ride from November 20 to January 1. Disneyland's trains are covered in our Anaheim guide.
train_links: Seven vintage railcars and a Metrolink locomotive at the Fullerton Train Station, free on the first and third Saturdays.
traditions: The Lions Club parade down Main Street on December 4, with Santa at the end.
Los Alamitos's free snow and Santa's Village evening on December 5.
The pier tree lighting with man-made snow, held November 21 this year.
Clay and Paint and Acrylic Painting classes on December 14 and 15.
kidfact: Seal Beach's parade has Santa last in line, so the best view is the end of Main Street.
faq: When is the Seal Beach Christmas Parade in 2026?
Friday, December 4, 2026, at 7 pm on Main Street from Ocean Avenue to Pacific Coast Highway.
Is the Seal Beach parade free?
Yes. Watching a public parade from the curb is free.
Is there a free snow event near Seal Beach?
Los Alamitos Winter Wonderland on Saturday, December 5, from 4 to 7:30 pm, is free and has snow sledding, Santa's Village and a tree lighting.
Has the Seal Beach tree lighting happened?
The chamber's page lists the pier tree lighting on November 21, so it has passed for 2026.
Is there a Christmas train in Seal Beach?
Not in the city. South Coast Plaza in Costa Mesa runs Santa's Express Train for $2 a ride.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Seal Beach for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 4 (Seal Beach Christmas Parade on Main Street) to December 15 (winter art classes at the Seal Beach and Los Alamitos-Rossmoor libraries), with Winter Wonderland at St. Isidore Historical Plaza in neighboring Los Alamitos (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Seal Beach

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Seal Beach, including neighboring Los Alamitos and Rossmoor (3 new and 1 moved over from the Long Beach page)
  • 2 free events: the Seal Beach Christmas Parade and Los Alamitos Winter Wonderland
  • Meet Santa: Santa at the end of the parade and in Santa's Village at Winter Wonderland with the Grinch
  • Snow: snow sledding and snow play zones at Winter Wonderland
  • Season: December 4 to December 15
